objective.text: Reject modified encrypted payloads rather than trusting decryptable-looking base64.

difficulty.rationale: Verify rejection of a modified protected value rather than only successful round trips.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The application uses Laravel’s AES-256-CBC encrypter. A test modifies the ciphertext value inside the payload but leaves its original MAC.

stem: Which result should the tampering regression test require?

options.text: decryptString throws DecryptException instead of returning trusted plaintext.
options.rationale: The MAC authenticates the protected payload, so changing ciphertext without a valid corresponding MAC must be rejected.

options.text: decryptString silently repairs the payload using the application key.
options.rationale: The encrypter does not infer and repair the intended original ciphertext.
options.misconception: The encrypter does not infer and repair the intended original ciphertext.

options.text: The modified outer value is accepted whenever it remains valid base64.
options.rationale: Base64 validity is only an encoding property, not authenticity.
options.misconception: Base64 validity is only an encoding property, not authenticity.

options.text: decryptString returns the changed bytes as a successful plaintext value.
options.rationale: That would ignore the integrity guarantee the test is meant to protect.
options.misconception: That would ignore the integrity guarantee the test is meant to protect.
